description: As part of RCBA’s Aptitude Test and Career Guidance initiative, supported by the HRI Foundation, 36 Grade 10 students from Sane Guruji Vidya Mandir participated in a three-stage programme conducted by VITAMELIORA LLP. The programme began with an orientation on 3 September 2026, followed by a written aptitude test on 22 September 2026. On 13 October 2026, individual discussions of the test reports were conducted with students and their parents by Mr Himanshu Dave and Ms Tejal Dave. The initiative aims to help students understand their aptitude and potential, explore suitable courses and college options, and make informed decisions about their future career paths.
